title: Stationarity in integral form is equivalent to vanishing first variation of mass (Simon 2.4)
statement: Assume (GF) (for every n ≥ 1, ℓ and every rectifiable n-varifold V: μ_V is finite on compacts, dim T_xV = n μ_V-a.e., and x ↦ p_{T_xV} is μ_V-a.e. strongly measurable) and FirstVariationFormula. Then StationaryIffVariational holds: for n ≥ 1, every pair a and every open U, V = mk a is stationary in U (∫ div_M X dμ_V = 0 for all C¹ fields X with compact support in U) if and only if t ↦ (imageMass a (φ t) K).toReal has derivative 0 at t = 0 for every compact variation (φ, ε, K) with K ⊆ U.
lean_statement: (∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ), 0 < n → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, Module.finrank ℝ (V.tangentSpace x) = n) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ (V.tangentSpace x).starProjection) V.weight) → FirstVariationFormula → StationaryIffVariational
